map.提示：A-a梯度增大提示换气障碍(肺实质/血管)，正常则提示低氧源于通气不足或吸: Note: a widened A-a gradient suggests a gas-exchange disorder (parenchyma/vascular); a normal gradient means hypoxemia comes from hypoventilation or low inspired oxygen. The oxygenation index (P/F) = PaO2/FiO2; <300 suggests acute lung injury, <200 (new standard <100) severe ARDS. Clinical reference only.

map.Ⅰ型/Ⅱ型呼衰: Type I / type II respiratory failure
map.FiO₂ 0.21：PAO₂=0.21×713=149.7；A-a=149.7−: FiO2 0.21: PAO2 = 0.21 x 713 = 149.7; A-a = 149.7 - 60/0.8 - 50 = 24.7 > 15.1 -> type II respiratory failure with widened gradient.
map.PaO₂<60 而 PaCO₂ 正常→Ⅰ型呼衰，提高吸氧浓度。: PaO2 <60 with normal PaCO2 -> type I respiratory failure; increase inspired oxygen.
map.PaO₂<60 即可诊断；伴 PaCO₂>50 为Ⅱ型(通气不足)。: PaO2 <60 is diagnostic; with PaCO2 >50 it is type II (hypoventilation).
map.PAO₂=FiO₂×(760−47)−PaCO₂/0.8；梯度随年龄增大。: PAO2 = FiO2 x (760 - 47) - PaCO2/0.8; the gradient widens with age.
